label: OpenCode: native submit и точная квитанция без повторной отправки
description: Независимая native часть V065A. Использовать уже проверенный connection/create и рабочий legacy send protocol, реализовать native control в adapters/opencode без core/schema. Поддерживать лишь доказанные mode; unsupported до эффекта.
acceptance: Fake native server фиксирует ровно один submit и точный instance/session receipt. Некорректный target/mode отклонён до запроса; неоднозначный ответ/timeout UNKNOWN без retry и без выдуманного native idempotency. Реальный isolated model send/read отдельно от port source proof.
note: Astra: после выполненного V064LIVE продолжать native ветку без ожидания общей MCP приёмки; V065A/B/aggregate сохраняют прежние public/core gates.

progress_events.note: Source-first: реализую только подтверждённый OpenCode native submit mode; unsupported modes отклоняются до запроса, local request key не выдаётся за native idempotency.
Owned source saved and fixture tests green; executing separate one-turn loopback dummy-provider live leaf.

changes.result: Native OpenCode submit port committed as 14f9738e, owned path only crates/herder/src/adapters/opencode/control.rs, on fresh origin/main base f18149d3 plus V064 commit 223424ba. OpenAPI 2.2.4 confirmed exact steer/queue delivery values and native 200 receipt id/sessionID/delivery. Current maps to steer only with a nonempty observed turn; Queue maps exactly; Start is rejected before POST because API has no idle CAS. Local request key is metadata correlation only, not idempotency. Three embedded fake-server tests passed: one exact submit/receipt, wrong-target/mode no-effect, timeout UNKNOWN/no retry/no fabricated ID. Not proven here: live model turn; MCP consumer.

OpenCode submit implementation committed as 14f9738e (control.rs only); final scoped source+evidence commit 2413cbca1a7c2f7ce573d379ae2c8c2b63c6efd0 includes the owned import cleanup and V065LIVE receipt. On fresh origin/main base f18149d3 plus V064 commit 223424ba, OpenAPI 2.2.4 confirms steer/queue and native 200 receipt id/sessionID/delivery. Current requires nonempty observed turn; Queue maps exactly; Start fails before POST because no idle CAS. Request key is correlation metadata, not idempotency. Three fixture tests passed: exact one submit/receipt, invalid target/mode no-effect, timeout UNKNOWN/no retry/no fabricated ID. Live model send evidence is V065LIVE. No public MCP consumer proof claimed.

OpenCode submit correction on top of 2413cbca: Current is rejected before POST because steer cannot atomically enforce expected_turn; Queue remains supported. Regression RED was observed before fix; focused regression plus all 4 temporary control fixture tests pass. Contract updated at acceptance/contracts/opencode.md. No live send repeated. rustfmt check unavailable because rustfmt component is absent.
